nodes.label: Delete account
nodes.unresolved: Product owner and finance: what happens to orders that are not delivered yet when the account is deleted?

nodes.label: Export my orders (CSV)
nodes.action: Downloads the customer's orders as a CSV file
nodes.detail: Added in the viewer during a review with the client; no requirement covers it yet.

sources.quote: The page shows the email the customer signs in with. The email cannot be changed here.
"Change password" sends a reset link to that email; the password is never typed on this page.
"Delete account" removes the account after the customer confirms. What happens to orders that are not delivered yet is still open
